segments.text: Is your empty drink can worth ten cents?
On the first of April, Singapore started the Beverage Container Return Scheme. Drinks in plastic bottles and metal cans now carry a ten-cent deposit.
There are around a thousand return machines across Singapore. Put in your empty can, and the machine pays your ten cents back!
Look for the Deposit Mark on your drink. Empty your can, keep it whole, and bring it to a return machine. Glass bottles and drink cartons don't go in the machine. They go in the blue recycling bin.
